content: Given that BERT is limited to a particular input length, we split the input sequence into segments of a fixed size with overlap. For each of these segments, we obtain H or P from BERT model. We then stack these segment-level representations into a sequence, which serves as input to a small (100-dimensional) LSTM layer. Its output serves as a document embedding. Finally, we use two fully connected layers with ReLU (30-dimensional) and softmax (the same dimensionality as the number of classes) activations to obtain the final predictions.
